programmes.name: AI Leadership: AI Strategy & Opportunity (Level 5 Apprenticeship Unit)
programmes.facts: Apprenticeship Unit ref. AU0009, not a full apprenticeship. Gives senior leaders frameworks to spot real AI opportunity and build a board-ready case. Minimum 30 hours over about 4 weeks, live online. Government-funded up to £750 for eligible non-levy employers.
programmes.pitch: a short, funded AI leadership unit that helps senior leaders work out where AI genuinely pays off and build a board-ready case for it. It runs live online over about four weeks
